warnings.t: If the door stood open too long the service menu appears. Tap [Exit] and then [Close the door and press here to leave service].

steps.t: Open the water supply.
Plug the power cable into an earthed socket.
Open the door.
Set the [ON/OFF] switch to ON.
s: The exact spot is on the inside-view drawing.

steps.t: Close the door.
The machine starts up.
The main screen appears, with ‘Filling boiler’ and then ‘Heating boilers’ in the message area.
After a few minutes ‘Heating boilers’ disappears and the machine is ready for use.

procedures.title: Switching the machine off / taking it out of service (Virtu, Lua)

warnings.t: If the machine stands idle for more than a week: do the monthly maintenance first, shut off the water supply and pull out the plug. That saves energy too.

steps.t: Open the door.
Set the [ON/OFF] switch to OFF.
s: The exact spot is on the inside-view drawing.

warnings.t: Do not leave the door open unattended; anyone can then get at the inside of the machine.

steps.t: Insert the key into the door lock.
Turn the key 90 degrees.
Open the door.
s: The service menu appears on the screen.

warnings.t: Check that all canisters are in place.
Always take the key out of the machine and out of any base cabinet, so nobody else can open the door.

steps.t: Insert the key into the door lock.
Turn the key 90 degrees.
Close the door.
Turn the key 90 degrees to lock the door.
Take the key out and store it safely.
Optional — leaving the service menu: tap [Exit] and then [Close the door and press here to leave service].

procedures.title: Opening or closing the top lid (Virtu, Lua)
procedures.purpose: To fill or clean the canisters they have to come out of the machine. The top lid gives easy access to them.

warnings.t: The top lid locks into the door and only opens when the door is open. Depending on the model it has cut-outs for one or two (bean) canisters.

steps.t: Opening: lift the top lid at the front and swing it back open. It stays upright.
Closing: swing the lid back down. Make sure it drops all the way and locks when the door closes.

procedures.title: The service key (Virtu, Lua)
procedures.purpose: For safety the machine switches off all dispensing functions when the door is opened. The green service key bypasses that safeguard for maintenance where the machine has to keep running.

warnings.t: With the service key fitted the machine is live while the door is open. Parts can move and hot water can come out. Only fit the key when you are asked to.

steps.t: Find the key opening on the inside of the door.
Insert the service key into the opening.
Turn the key a quarter turn (90°).
s: The grey options in the service menu turn yellow or green.
The machine now works fully with the door open.
The key stays locked in the opening.

steps.t: Turn the service key a quarter turn (90°).
Take the service key out of the door.

procedures.title: Scheduled flush (Virtu, Lua)
procedures.intervalText: Daily, announced on the screen
procedures.purpose: Cleaning does get skipped or forgotten now and then. The scheduled flush is therefore forced by the scheduler every day. Instead of it you can also run the daily or weekly maintenance.

steps.t: Put a rinsing tub or jug under the outlet to catch the rinse water.
Tap [Place cup and press here] on the screen.
s: Hot water from the boiler runs through the mixers and the brewer.

steps.t: A progress screen appears.
s: Wait until the flush is finished.
The flush takes 1 to 2 minutes.

steps.t: Remove the rinsing tub.
The machine returns to the main menu and is ready for use.

procedures.title: Flushing the mixers and brewer (Virtu)
procedures.intervalText: At least daily, more often if needed. Takes 1 to 2 minutes
procedures.purpose: The flush drives hot water through the mixers and the brewer to rinse residue away.

steps.t: If needed, open the door so the service menu appears on the screen.
Close the door.
Put a rinsing tub under the outlet to catch the hot waste water.
In the service menu tap [Maintenance] and then [Daily Cleaning Cycle].
s: Hot water from the boiler runs through the mixers and the brewer.

steps.t: Repeat the previous step until clean water comes out of the machine.

procedures.title: Cleaning the waste bucket (Virtu)
procedures.intervalText: Daily
procedures.purpose: After every dispense the coffee grounds (the puck) go into the waste bucket. Surplus water from the brewer is caught in a drip bucket standing in the waste bucket, just below the brewer. With an external waste bin the waste bucket is replaced by a waste guide.

steps.t: Depending on the type of bucket:
s: B) take the waste bucket (with the drip bucket inside) out of the machine, or
G) take the drip bucket and the waste guide out of the machine.

steps.t: Rinse the parts you took out with clean warm water.
Dry everything completely.
Put the buckets back.
s: B) put the drip bucket into the waste bucket and put them back together, or
G) put the drip bucket on the left and the waste guide on the right in the machine.

steps.t: Check that the water level sensor hangs in the drip bucket.

procedures.title: Cleaning the cup stand (Virtu)
procedures.intervalText: Daily
procedures.purpose: For cleaning, the cup stands have to come out of the machine.

warnings.t: Depending on the model the machine has one or two cup stands.

steps.t: Hold the cup stand and pull one leg off the hinge pin.
Lift one side slightly and move the other leg in the direction of the arrow off the second hinge pin.
Repeat the steps for the second cup stand, if there is one.
Rinse every part you took out with clean warm water.
Refitting: put one leg of the cup stand on the hinge pin in the door.
Turn the cup stand to the other hinge pin and push the leg onto it with some force.
Repeat the last steps for the second cup stand.

procedures.title: Cleaning the waste bucket in the base cabinet (Virtu)
procedures.intervalText: Weekly, more often if needed
procedures.purpose: If the machine stands on a base cabinet, surplus water from the brewer and waste water from the drip tray go to the left waste bucket and the coffee grounds to the right one. Both have to be cleaned regularly.

steps.t: Take the waste bucket(s) out of the base cabinet.
Rinse them with clean warm water.
Dry them completely.
Put the waste bucket(s) back in the base cabinet.
If one is used, check that the waste-water level sensor hangs in the left bucket.
If the message ‘Waste bucket full / Empty waste bucket’ is on the screen: in the service menu tap [Maintenance] and then [Reset waste bin] to reset the counter and clear the message.

procedures.title: Cleaning the drip tray (Virtu)
procedures.intervalText: Daily
procedures.purpose: The drip tray catches waste water from the machine and from dispensing and has to be cleaned regularly. It sits under the jug stand. Depending on the model there is a metal grid in it.

warnings.t: If the drip tray overflows into a larger waste bucket or straight into the drain, the interval may be once a week.
Make sure the lugs on the back of the jug stand (3) drop into the cut-outs in the door (1).

steps.t: Lift the jug stand at the front and take it out of the guides in the door.
s: Depending on the model there is a metal insert grid in it that also has to come out.

steps.t: Pull the drip tray out of the machine in the direction of the arrow.
Rinse every part you took out with clean warm water.
Dry everything.
Put the drip tray back.
Put the jug stand on the guides (2) and slide it in the direction of the arrow.
Push the jug stand down so it sits firmly on the door and the guides (2).
Depending on the model: put the metal insert grid back.

procedures.title: Clean the mixing system (Virtu, Lua)
procedures.intervalText: Weekly, more often if needed
procedures.purpose: To prevent clogging by ingredients, the mixers have to come out of the machine and be cleaned.

warnings.t: Make sure the extraction filter is completely dry before you put it in the filter drawer.
Make sure the arrow on the mixer propeller points to the flat side of the shaft.
Make sure the mixer extraction connects properly to the opening in the filter drawer.

steps.t: Take the outlet hoses off the mixers.
Take off the canister outlets and remember the correct position and place of each outlet.
Turn the bayonet catches to the left (about 10°).
Pull the mixer housings out of the machine in the direction of the arrow.
Pull the mixer propellers off the shaft in the direction of the arrow.
Turn the bayonet catches to the left again (about 10°) to release them and pull them out of the machine in the direction of the arrow.
Pull the drawer with the extraction filter out of the machine in the direction of the arrow.
Take the extraction filter out of the drawer.
Rinse all removed parts of the mixing system with clean warm water.
s: Clean the inside of the hoses with a hose brush and pay attention to the inner bends.

steps.t: Clean the parts of the mixing system that stay in the machine with a brush.

Make sure ALL parts are dry before you reassemble the mixing system. Tip: if you have a hygiene kit, use the clean, dry parts from it — you can clean the removed parts after the machine is running again.
Put the extraction filter in the filter drawer.
Put the filter drawer back.
Put the bayonet catches back and turn them to the right (about 10°).
Fit the mixer propellers.
Fit the mixer housings.
Turn the bayonet catches to the right to lock the mixer housings.
Put the canister outlets back on the canisters and check that the place and position are correct.
Connect the outlet hoses to the mixers again.

procedures.title: Remove and clean the brewer (Virtu)
procedures.intervalText: At least weekly, more often if needed
procedures.purpose: For a complete cleaning with water the brewer has to come out of the machine. The brewer holder must be checked and cleaned too, otherwise the brewer will start to fail.

warnings.t: Do not take the brewer itself apart. Only trained personnel may work on the brewer itself; this is described in the technical manual.
If the brewer is not fitted correctly, it can cause faults or jump out of its holder during brewing.

steps.t: Disconnect the brewer outlet from the brewer, together with the connecting hose and the outlet nozzle.
Find the locking lever on the brewer.
Push the locking lever up, hold it up and pull and lift the brewer out of the machine in the direction of the arrow.
Check that the brewer holder in the machine is clean; clean the water connection (A) and the motor coupling (B).
Rinse the brewer and the other removed parts with clean warm water.
s: Clean the inside of all hoses with the hose brush and pay extra attention to the inner bends.

steps.t: Use a small pipe brush to remove the residues from the outlet tubes of the brewer.
Place the brewer on the holder and push it firmly until you hear the click.
s: Check that the locking lever is down.

steps.t: Fit the brewer outlet with the outlet hose.
s: Push the CoEx outlet all the way onto the outlet tubes of the brewer head, otherwise it will leak.

procedures.title: Cleaning the brewer with a cleaning tablet (Virtu)
procedures.intervalText: At least once a week, more often if needed. The cycle takes 8 minutes
procedures.purpose: Cleaning with a tablet removes all coffee residue from the brewer.
needed: Protective clothing, gloves and safety goggles

warnings.t: If you do not clean the brewer with the manufacturer's prescribed tablet, the warranty on the parts concerned lapses. Not cleaning can make the machine fail. Advice: at least once a week. If you have trouble with clogged filter heads, do it more often.
After 7 days without cleaning a message appears. After 9 days a message appears and coffee dispensing is blocked.
Wear protective clothing, gloves and safety goggles when working with cleaning tablets.
Never break off the cleaning cycle. If the cycle did not run through completely, do the whole procedure again.

steps.t: Open the door.
In the service menu tap [Maintenance] and then [Brewer cleaning cycle].
Put the cleaning tablet into the brewer.
Put a rinsing tub under the outlet.
Put the service key in the door.
In the service menu tap [Start the cleaning cycle].
s: Wait until the cleaning cycle is completely finished.

steps.t: Take the service key out of the door.
Take the rinsing tub away and empty it.

procedures.title: Clearing the grinder (Virtu)
procedures.intervalText: With the message ‘Grinder blocked’
procedures.purpose: Sometimes there is a twig or a stone among the fresh beans. The grinder stops when such a foreign object blocks it; ‘Grinder blocked’ appears in the message area.

warnings.t: Keep the door open and never fit the service key — the grinder could start up unexpectedly.
The grinder is full of beans and ground coffee. Turn the grinder housing upside down and it falls out.
With nothing in the way any more, the shaft turns smoothly.

steps.t: Find the grinder that is jammed.
Take the canister away so you can get at the grinder.
Work out which type of grinder it is — there are two:
s: D) the D grinder, recognisable by its removable upper housing, or
S) the original Schaerer grinder, with a gear-like top.

steps.t: Schaerer grinder: lift the grinder out of the grinder base.
Hold the grinder upside down. Turn the square top in the gear (or the shaft at the bottom) back and forth until the foreign object comes loose and falls out. Then continue at step 12.
D grinder: lift the grinder out of its base.
Release the clips of the grinder outlet (1), slide the outlet off the grinder housing (2) and take it off.
Turn the bayonet-locked upper housing in the direction of the arrow and take it off the grinder.
Clean both grinding discs and the inside of the grinder housing.
Put the upper housing back and turn it in the direction of the arrow to lock it.
Slide the outlet onto the grinder housing in the direction of the arrow.
s: Check that the clips click home properly.

steps.t: Put the grinder back in the grinder base. Tip: turn the square top slightly so the splined shaft drops into the grinder motor and the grinder seats fully.
Put the canister back.
Close the door and lock it.
Leave the service menu. Tip: draw two cups of coffee to fill the grinder with fresh coffee and throw them away.
Check operation with a test coffee.

procedures.title: Filling the cup dispenser
procedures.intervalText: When needed
procedures.purpose: Only on machines with a cup dispenser. Refill in time, otherwise the machine cannot dispense drinks. A cup can always be placed by hand.
needed: Paper or plastic cups for coffee machines (diameter 70 or 73 mm)

warnings.t: Take care when opening the dispenser door: cups can fall out.

steps.t: Open the door of the machine.
On the inside of the door, flip the locking lever of the cup dispenser up.
Open the dispenser door.
Put the new cups into the dispenser door.
s: Three stacks at most. Start with the stack on the right.

steps.t: Do not stack higher than the upper support plate, or the cups get damaged. Take away every cup above the support plate.
Close the dispenser door and lock it.

procedures.title: Clean the tea brewer
procedures.intervalText: Weekly
procedures.purpose: Cleaning removes all residue from the tea brewer. For that it has to come out of the machine.

steps.t: Open the door.
Take the brewer out of the holder.
s: Push the lower part of the holder (A) down and hold it.
Tilt the tea brewer in the direction of the arrow (B) to free it from the lower fixing.
Lower the brewer (C) out of the upper fold of the holder.

steps.t: Take the hose off the dispensing arm.
Take the tea brewer apart.
Clean every part, including the hose, with warm water.
Put the tea brewer back together.
Put the brewer back.
s: Put the brewer into the upper fold of the holder (A).
Push the lower part into the holder (B) and check that it locks properly.

steps.t: Fit the hose onto the dispensing arm.

procedures.title: Cleaning the canisters (Virtu, Lua)
procedures.intervalText: Monthly, more often if needed
procedures.purpose: Every ingredient leaves residue in the canister. For cleaning, the canisters have to come out of the machine.

warnings.t: Never fit the service key — the machine could start up unexpectedly.
If warm water alone is not enough, use a mild cleaning agent.
Only fill the canisters once they are completely dry. Otherwise the product clumps and the system jams.

steps.t: Open the door.
Open the top lid of the machine.
Take the canisters out of the machine.
Unlock (optional) and take the lid off the canisters.
Empty the canisters.
Clean the canisters with warm water.
Dry the canisters thoroughly inside and out.

procedures.title: Filling the ingredient canisters (Virtu, Lua)
procedures.intervalText: Daily or when needed
procedures.purpose: Refill in time, otherwise the machine cannot dispense drinks.

warnings.t: Keep at least a 4 cm layer of product in the canisters. Only use ingredients the supplier specifies.
Never fit the service key — the machine could start up unexpectedly.
Fill the canisters outside the machine.
Make sure the drive at the back of the canister seats properly in the motor drive.
Check the position of the canister outlet: it has to point at the right mixing bowl.

steps.t: Open the door.
Open the top lid of the machine.
Remember (or note down) the position of the outlets and turn the canister outlets up.
Lift the canister slightly at the front until the locking lug (see inset) is visible.
Pull the canister towards you and take it out of the machine.
Take the lid off and put the canister on a stable surface.
Fill the canister with the ingredient named on it. Tip: do not fill more than you use in one or two days, then the product stays fresh.
Put the lid back on and put the canister back in the machine.
Turn the canister outlets back down.
Close the top lid.

procedures.title: Filling the bean canister (Virtu, Lua)
procedures.intervalText: Daily or when needed
procedures.purpose: Refill in time, otherwise the machine cannot dispense drinks.

warnings.t: Never fit the service key — the grinder could start up unexpectedly.
Fill the canister outside the machine.
If you do not pull the locking slider all the way out, the beans fall out of the canister.

steps.t: Open the door.
Open the top lid of the machine.
Find the locking slider between the grinder and the bean canister.
Pull the locking slider in the direction of the arrow. The bean canister closes and comes free of the grinder base.
Lift the bean canister off the grinder base and take it out of the machine.
Put the bean canister on a stable, level surface.
Unlock the lid (optional). Lift the lid at the front and pull it off the canister in the direction of the arrow.
Fill the canister with fresh coffee beans. Tip: fill for one or two days, then the beans stay fresh.
Put the back of the lid on the canister and lower the front. Lock the lid (optional).
Put the bean canister back onto the four locating lugs of the grinder base.
Push the locking slider back in the direction of the arrow to open the canister and secure it to the grinder base.
Repeat the procedure for any other bean canisters.

procedures.title: Cleaning the cold water outlet (Virtu, Lua)
procedures.intervalText: Weekly, more often depending on use and surroundings
procedures.purpose: The cold water outlet has to be cleaned regularly to prevent bacterial growth.
needed: Protective clothing, gloves and safety goggles

warnings.t: Do not use aggressive cleaning products or abrasives on (parts of) the machine.
Wear protective clothing, gloves and safety goggles when working with cleaning chemicals.

steps.t: Dip a clean cloth in the cleaning agent (concentration as specified by the manufacturer) and wring it out well.
Wipe the whole cold water outlet with the cloth; dip the cloth again if needed.
Rinse the cloth in clean warm water and wipe off the remains of cleaning agent and dirt.
Dry the cold water outlet with disposable paper towels.
Close the door of the machine.
Put a rinsing tub under the cold water outlet.
Leave the service menu.
Select a full jug of cold water and draw at least 1 litre, so all traces of cleaning agent are rinsed away.

procedures.title: Deep-cleaning the cold water outlet (Virtu, Lua)
procedures.intervalText: Monthly, more often depending on use and surroundings
procedures.purpose: The cold water outlet has to be cleaned and disinfected regularly to prevent bacterial growth.
needed: Protective clothing, gloves and safety goggles

warnings.t: Do not use aggressive cleaning products or abrasives on (parts of) the machine.
Wear protective clothing, gloves and safety goggles when working with cleaning chemicals.

steps.t: Dip a clean cloth in warm water and give the cold water outlet a first wipe.
Dip a clean cloth in the cleaning agent (concentration as specified) and wring it out.
Wipe the whole cold water outlet; dip the cloth again if needed.
Brush around the cold water outlet to loosen dried-on dirt and wipe it away with a cloth.
Soak a clean disposable cloth in clean warm water and rinse the outlet until all dirt and cleaning residue is gone.
Soak a clean disposable cloth in disinfectant and wipe the whole area.
Leave it to work for 10 minutes.
Rinse off the disinfectant with a disposable cloth and clean warm water.
Dry the cold water outlet with disposable paper towels.
Close the door of the machine.
Put a rinsing tub under the cold water outlet.
Leave the service menu.
Select a full jug of cold water and draw at least 1 litre, so all residue is rinsed away.

procedures.title: Entering canister levels (Virtu)
procedures.intervalText: Appears when you leave the service menu, if this option is switched on
procedures.purpose: With this option switched on, the machine reports when the canisters are nearly empty. From the number of drinks dispensed the machine works out how much is left. After refilling, the counters have to be reset.

warnings.t: A full canister is 100%. To keep the product fresh you can also fill to 50%.

steps.t: If you tap [Exit] to leave the service menu, the screen with the ingredient levels appears.
s: Each canister shows its current level (only the canisters for which the option is switched on).

steps.t: Tap an ingredient button in the left column to change a level.
s: Or tap [Exit] to leave the service menu.

steps.t: Tap the correct [fill level %] for the canister you chose.
Repeat this for every canister you refilled (or where the value is wrong), or tap [Exit].

procedures.title: Cleaning the outside of the machine (Virtu, Lua)
procedures.intervalText: Daily
procedures.purpose: Clean every outside surface that no other procedure covers.

warnings.t: Do not use aggressive cleaning products or abrasives on (parts of) the machine.

steps.t: Wipe every outside surface with a soft, damp cloth.

procedures.title: Cleaning the touchscreen (Virtu)
procedures.intervalText: At least daily, and whenever the screen asks for it
procedures.purpose: The touchscreen is the main link between the user and the machine. For hygienic and fault-free use it has to be cleaned regularly.

warnings.t: Do not use other (aggressive) chemicals on the touchscreen. Avoid dripping: not too much liquid on the cloth.

steps.t: Tap one of the buttons with the message [PRESS here to clean]. The screen goes off.
s: Or tap [Cancel] to go back to the main menu.
Tip: if the cleaning window does not appear, first tap the clock on the screen. If no clock is visible, tap the spot where the clock should be.

steps.t: Clean the touchscreen with a little (isopropyl) alcohol on a clean soft cloth.
After a short while the screen comes back on, the machine returns to the main menu and is ready for use.

warnings.t: If the door stood open too long the service menu appears. Tap [Exit] and answer the question ‘Do you want to leave the service menu’ with [OK].

steps.t: Open the water supply.
Plug the power cable into an earthed socket.
Open the door.
Set the [ON/OFF] switch to ON.
s: The exact spot is on the inside-view drawing.

steps.t: Close the door.
The machine starts up.
The main screen appears, first with ‘Filling boiler’ and then ‘Heating boilers’.
After a few minutes ‘Heating boilers’ disappears and the machine is ready for use.

warnings.t: Check that all canisters are in place.
Always take the key out of the machine and out of any base cabinet.

steps.t: Insert the key into the door lock.
Turn the key 90 degrees.
Close the door.
Turn the key 90 degrees to lock the door.
Take the key out and store it safely.
Optional — leaving the service menu: tap [Exit] and answer the question ‘Do you want to leave the service menu’ with [OK].

procedures.title: Flushing the mixers and brewer (Lua, Avy)
procedures.intervalText: At least daily, more often if needed. Takes 1 to 2 minutes
procedures.purpose: The flush drives hot water through the mixers and the brewer to rinse residue away.

steps.t: If needed, open the door so the service menu appears on the screen.
Put the service key in the door, or close the door.
Put a rinsing tub under the outlet to catch the hot waste water.
Tap [Daily rinse] and follow the instructions on the screen.
Tap [Next] to start the flush.
s: Hot water from the boiler runs through the mixers and the brewer.

steps.t: Repeat the previous step until clean water comes out of the machine.

procedures.title: Cleaning the waste bucket (Lua, Avy)
procedures.intervalText: Daily
procedures.purpose: After every dispense the coffee puck goes into the waste bucket. Surplus water from the brewer is caught in a drip bucket standing inside it.

warnings.t: With a fixed waste-water connection there is no need for a drip bucket or waste-water bucket.

steps.t: Fold the dispensing arm with the nozzles up.
Depending on the type of bucket:
s: B) take the waste bucket (with the drip bucket inside) out of the machine, or
G) take the waste guide and the water bucket out of the machine.

steps.t: Rinse the parts you took out with clean warm water.
Dry everything completely.
Put the buckets back:
s: B) put the drip bucket into the waste bucket and put them back together, or
G) put the water bucket on the right and the waste guide on the left in the machine.

steps.t: Fold the dispensing arm back to its normal position.

procedures.title: Cleaning the cup stand (Lua, Avy)
procedures.intervalText: Daily
procedures.purpose: The cup stand has to be taken out of the machine and cleaned regularly.

steps.t: Pull the cup stand off the magnetic mounting point and take it out of the door.
Rinse the cup stand with clean warm water and dry it thoroughly afterwards.
Put the cup stand back on the magnetic mounting point in the door.

procedures.title: Cleaning the waste bucket in the base cabinet (Lua, Avy)
procedures.intervalText: Weekly, more often if needed
procedures.purpose: If the machine stands on a base cabinet, the buckets inside may be replaced by a waste guide and a fixed waste-water connection.

warnings.t: With a fixed waste-water connection there is no waste-water bucket in it.
The base cabinet has to be locked for safety. Do not leave the base cabinet door open unattended.

steps.t: Take the waste bucket out of the base cabinet.
Rinse the bucket with clean warm water.
Dry the bucket completely.
Put the waste bucket back in the base cabinet, under the waste guide.
Close the base cabinet door, lock it and store the key safely.
If the message ‘Waste bucket full / Empty waste bucket’ is on the screen: in the service menu tap [Reset waste bin] to reset the counter and clear the message.

procedures.title: Cleaning the drip tray (Lua, Avy)
procedures.intervalText: Daily
procedures.purpose: The drip tray catches waste water from the machine and from dispensing, and has to be cleaned regularly.

warnings.t: If the drip tray overflows into a larger waste bucket or straight into the drain, the interval may be once a week.
Make sure the lug on the back of the jug stand (3) drops into the cut-out in the door (1).

steps.t: Pull the jug stand out of the guides in the door in the direction of the arrow.
Pull the drip tray out of the machine in the direction of the arrow.
Rinse every part you took out with clean warm water.
Dry everything.
Put the drip tray back.
Put the jug stand on the guides (2) and slide it in the direction of the arrow up against the door.

procedures.title: Remove and clean the brewer (CoEx XL)
procedures.intervalText: At least once a week, more often if needed
procedures.purpose: For cleaning with water the brewer has to come out of the machine. The mounting frame must be checked and cleaned too.

warnings.t: Do not take the brewer itself apart. Only trained personnel may work on the brewer itself; this is described in the technical manual.
Water and ground coffee can fall out of the brewer.
If the brewer is not fitted correctly, 'Brewer out of position' appears and coffee dispensing is blocked.

steps.t: Open the door; the service menu appears.
In the service menu, tap [Manual Brewer Cleaning].
s: Follow the instructions on the screen; they match the steps below.

steps.t: Put the service key in the door.
Tap [Next].
s: The brewer moves to the manual cleaning position. Wait until the message 'The CoEx XL brewer is now ready for manual cleaning' appears.

steps.t: Take out the service key.
Take the coffee outlet and the hose out of the outlet arm and clean them with warm water.
s: Clean the inside of the hoses with a hose brush and pay attention to the inner bends.

steps.t: Take the brewer out of the machine: four fingers in the lower grip (1), press and hold the locking grip (2) with your thumb, and pull the brewer out of the frame in the direction of the arrow (3).
Put the brewer on a flat surface. Find the unlocking marks on the sides of the cover (see inset). Pull the sides a few millimetres outwards there and lift the cover off the brewer.
Clean the brewer with clean warm water (a mild cleaning agent is allowed).
Put the cover on the brewer and press it on. Check that all sides click into place.
Check that the inside of the mounting frame in the machine is clean.
Slide the brewer into the frame and push it in the direction of the arrow (1) until it locks. The locking grip (green in the image) must no longer be pressed in.
Put the coffee outlet in the outlet arm and connect the hose to the connector on the mounting frame.
In the service menu, tap [Done] to finish the procedure.

procedures.title: Cleaning the brewer with a cleaning tablet (CoEx XL)
procedures.intervalText: At least once a week, more often if needed. The cycle takes 8 minutes
procedures.purpose: Cleaning with a tablet removes all coffee residue from the brewer. The brewer stays in the machine.
needed: Protective clothing, gloves and safety goggles

warnings.t: If you do not clean the brewer with the manufacturer's prescribed tablet, the warranty on the parts concerned lapses.
After 7 days without cleaning a message appears. After 9 days a message appears and coffee dispensing is blocked.
Wear protective clothing, gloves and safety goggles when working with cleaning tablets.
Never break off the cleaning cycle. If the cycle did not run through completely, do the whole procedure again.

steps.t: Open the door; the service menu appears.
In the service menu tap [Brewer Cleaning].
s: Follow the instructions on the screen; they match the steps below.

steps.t: Put a 1-litre jug or a rinsing tub under the outlet.
Put the service key in the door.
Tap [Next].
s: The first part of the cleaning starts; wait until the flush is finished.

steps.t: Tap [Next] to move the brewer into the right position.
Wait until the next steps appear on the screen.
Drop a cleaning tablet into the brewer.
Tap [Next] to continue.
s: Wait until the cleaning cycle is completely finished (about 8 minutes) and the last part appears.

steps.t: Tap [Done] to finish the procedure.
Take the service key out of the door.
Take the rinsing tub away and empty it.

procedures.title: Clearing the grinder (CoEx XL)
procedures.intervalText: With the message ‘Grinder blocked’
procedures.purpose: Sometimes there is a twig or a stone among the fresh beans. The grinder stops when such a foreign object blocks it.

warnings.t: Keep the door open and never fit the service key — the grinder could start up unexpectedly.

steps.t: Find the grinder that is jammed.
Take the canister away so you can get at the grinder.
Lift the grinder out of its base.
Release the clips (1) of the grinder outlet, slide the outlet (2) off the grinder housing and take it off.
Turn the bayonet-locked upper housing in the direction of the arrow and take it off the grinder.
Clean both grinding discs and the inside of the grinder housing.
Put the upper housing back and turn it in the direction of the arrow to lock it.
Slide the outlet onto the grinder housing in the direction of the arrow.
s: Check that the clips click home properly.

steps.t: Put the grinder back in the grinder base.
Put the canister back.
Close the door and lock it.
Leave the service menu. Tip: draw two cups of coffee to fill the grinder with fresh coffee and throw them away.
Check operation with a test coffee.

procedures.title: Entering canister levels (CoEx XL)
procedures.intervalText: Appears when you open the door, if this option is switched on
procedures.purpose: With this option switched on, the machine reports ‘Canister % almost empty’ as soon as a canister is nearly empty. After refilling, the levels have to be entered again.

warnings.t: A full canister is 100%. To keep the product fresh you can also fill to 50%.

steps.t: When you open the door the screen with the ingredient levels appears.
s: Each canister shows its current level (only the canisters for which the option is switched on).

steps.t: Tap [Edit fill levels] (A) first to change a level.
s: Or tap [Exit] to leave the service menu.

steps.t: A slider appears for every active canister. Tap the level or slide to the right value.
Repeat this for every canister you refilled (or where the value is wrong).
Tap [Save fill levels] (B) to store the setting.
Tap [Exit] to leave the service menu.

procedures.title: Cleaning the touchscreen (CoEx XL)
procedures.intervalText: At least daily, and whenever the screen asks for it
procedures.purpose: The touchscreen is the main link between the user and the machine. For hygienic and fault-free use it has to be cleaned regularly.

warnings.t: Do not use other (aggressive) chemicals on the touchscreen. Avoid dripping: not too much liquid on the cloth.

steps.t: Tap one of the buttons with the message [PRESS here to clean]. The screen goes off.
s: Or tap [Cancel] to go back to the main menu.

Tip: if the cleaning window does not appear, press and hold the message area at the bottom right. Or open the door: in the service menu tap the [shiny hand] at the top. A countdown then runs with the available cleaning time.

steps.t: Clean the touchscreen with a little (isopropyl) alcohol on a clean soft cloth.
After a short while the screen comes back on, the machine returns to the main menu and is ready for use.

warnings.t: If the door was left open for too long the Service menu is shown. Tap the [Exit] button and then the [OK] button to answer the question 'Do you want to leave the service menu' to leave the Service menu.

steps.t: Turn on the water supply.
Connect the power cord to an earthed power socket.
Open the door.
Switch the [ON/OFF] power switch to the ON position.
s: check the drawing of the inside view for the precise location.

steps.t: Close the door.
The coffee machine will start up.
The main screen is displayed with the message 'Filling boiler' and then 'Heating boilers' in the User message area.
After a few minutes the message 'Heating boilers' disappears and the machine is ready for use.

warnings.t: Do not leave the door open unattended to prevent unauthorized access to the inside of the machine.

steps.t: Insert the key in the lock of the door of the coffee machine.
Turn the key 90 degrees.
Open the door.
s: The Service menu is displayed on the screen.

warnings.t: Make sure all canisters are installed.
Always remove the key from the coffee machine and optional base cabinet to prevent unauthorized opening of the door.

steps.t: Insert the key in the lock of the door of the coffee machine.
Turn the key 90 degrees.
Close the door.
Turn the key 90 degrees to lock the door.
Remove the key and store it in a safe place.
(Optional) To leave the Service menu: Tap the [Exit] button and then the [OK] button to answer the question 'Do you want to leave the service menu' to leave the Service menu.

procedures.title: Bovenklep openen of sluiten (Rosa)
procedures.purpose: To fill up or clean the canisters they need to be removed from the coffee machine. To allow easy access to the canisters, the top lid of the coffee machine can be opened.

warnings.t: The top lid locks inside the door and can only be opened if the door is opened. Depending on the model, the top lid can contain cut outs for one or two (bean) canisters.

steps.t: To open, lift the top lid in the front and swing it open to the back. The top lid stays open in the upright position.
To close, swing the opened top lid back down. Make sure it is lowered completely and locks when the door is closed.
Open the door.
Switch the [ON/OFF] power switch to the OFF position.
s: check the drawing of the inside view for the precise location.
If the coffee machine is not used for a longer period of time (more than one week) it is recommended to:
perform daily maintenance or, if the machine is not used for a longer time, it is recommended to perform monthly maintenance.
turn off the water supply.
switch off the power supply (pulling the plug from the wall socket is sufficient). This will also prevent unnecessary use of energy. Also see section Extended down time.

procedures.title: Geplande spoeling (Rosa)
procedures.intervalText: Daily, announced on screen
procedures.purpose: Cleaning the coffee machine can be skipped or forgotten. The scheduled rinse is forced every day using a scheduler. When activated follow the procedure below to perform the rinse. Instead you can also run the daily maintenance or weekly maintenance.
needed: A rinsing tub or 1 liter jug

steps.t: Place a rinsing tub or jug under the outlet nozzle to collect the rinse water.
Tap the button [Place cup and press here] on the screen.
s: Hot water from the boiler flows through the mixers and brewer.

steps.t: A progress screen is shown.
s: Wait until the rinse procedure is finished.
Total time to rinse is 1 to 2 minutes.

steps.t: Remove the rinsing tub.
The machine returns to the Main menu and is ready for use.

procedures.title: Mixers en brewer doorspoelen (Rosa)
procedures.intervalText: At least daily, increase the frequency if needed Total time • Total time needed to rinse is 1 to 2 minutes.
procedures.purpose: The Rinse process flushes hot water through the mixers and the brewer to remove any residue.

steps.t: If needed open the door to show the Service menu on the touchscreen.
Insert the service key in the door or close the door.
Place a rinsing tub underneath the outlet nozzle to collect the hot waste water.
Tap the [Daily rinse] button and follow the instructions on the screen.
Tap the [Next] button to start the rinsing process.
s: Hot water from the boiler flows through the mixers and brewer.

steps.t: Repeat the previous step until clean water comes out of the machine.

procedures.title: Afvalemmer reinigen (Rosa)
procedures.intervalText: Daily.
procedures.purpose: Used coffee filter paper and coffee residue is transported into the waste bucket. A metal waste disposer inside the waste bucket ensures a better distribution of the waste. Regular cleaning is needed. If an external waste bin is used, the waste bucket and disposer (B) are replaced by a waste guide (G). Perform the following steps:

steps.t: Depending on your model:
s: (B) remove the waste bucket and metal waste disposer.
(G) remove the waste guide.

steps.t: Rinse the removed item(s) with clean warm water.
Dry the item(s) completely.
Depending on your model:
s: (B) Install the waste bucket and hang the metal waste disposer on the left side of the waste bucket.
(G) Install the waste guide.

procedures.title: Bekerstandaard reinigen (Rosa)
procedures.intervalText: Daily
procedures.purpose: The cup stand needs to be removed from the machine and cleaned regularly.

steps.t: Pull the cup stand from the magnetic suspension point and remove it from the door.
Rinse the cup stand with clean warm water and dry it thoroughly afterwards.
Place the cup stand back in the magnetic suspension point in the door.

procedures.title: Clean the waste bin in the base cabinet (Rosa)
procedures.intervalText: Weekly, increase the frequency if needed
procedures.purpose: If waste bins in a base cabinet (or other external cabinet) are installed, excess water from the brewer and waste water from the drip tray is captured in the left waste bin and coffee residue in the right waste bin. Both bins must be cleaned regularly.

warnings.t: If a fixed waste water connection is used, a waste water bin is not installed.

steps.t: Remove the waste bin(s) from the base cabinet.
Rinse the removed bin(s) with clean warm water.
Dry the bin(s) completely.
Place the waste bin(s) in the base cabinet.
When used, make sure that the sensor for the waste water level is placed inside the left waste water bin.
If the coffee machine displays the message 'Waste bucket full / Empty waste bucket', tap the [Reset waste bin] button in the Service menu to reset the counter and remove the message.

procedures.title: Clean the drip tray (Rosa)
procedures.intervalText: Daily
procedures.purpose: The drip tray collects waste water from the coffee machine and waste water during the dispense of products and needs to be cleaned regularly. The drip tray is covered by the jug stand.

warnings.t: If the drip tray is connected to a larger waste bucket/bin or directly into the main waste water disposal, the cleaning interval can be lowered to once a week.
Make sure that the ledge on the back of the jug stand (3) fits inside the notch in the door (1).

steps.t: Pull the jug stand from the door in the direction of the arrow and remove it from the support guides in the door.
Pull the drip tray in the direction of the arrow and remove it from the machine.
Rinse all removed items with clean warm water.
Dry all items.
Place the drip tray.
Place the jug stand on the guides (2), slide it in the direction of the arrow against the door.

procedures.title: Mixsysteem reinigen (Rosa)
procedures.intervalText: Weekly, increase the frequency if needed
procedures.purpose: To prevent clogging of ingredients the mixers must be removed from the coffee machine and cleaned.

warnings.t: Make sure the exhaust filter is completely dry before installing it in the filter drawer.
Make sure that the arrow on the mixer propeller points in the direction of the flat side of the shaft.
Make sure that the mixer suction trap connects properly to the opening in the filter drawer.

steps.t: Remove the outlet hoses from the mixers.
Remove the canister outlets and remember the correct position and location of each outlet.
Turn the bayonet catches counterclockwise (approx. 10º).
Pull the mixer houses in the direction of the arrow and remove them from the machine.
Pull the mixer propellers in the direction of the arrow and away from the shaft.
Turn the bayonet catches counterclockwise (approx. 10º) again to release and pull them in the direction of the arrow away from the machine.
Pull the exhaust filter drawer in the direction of the arrow and remove it from the machine.
Remove the exhaust filter from the drawer.
Rinse out all removed parts of the mixing system with clean warm water.
s: Make sure to clean the inside of the hoses with a hose cleaning brush and pay attention to inside corners in the hoses.

steps.t: Clean the parts of the mixing system that remain in the machine with a brush.

Before continuing with the installation of the mixing system make sure ALL parts are dry. TIP When available, use the clean and dry parts from the hygiene kit. The cleaning of the removed parts can be done after the machine has been put in operation again.
Insert the mixer exhaust filter in the filter drawer.
Install the filter drawer.
Install the bayonet catches and turn clockwise (approx. 10º).
Install the mixer propellers.
Install the mixer houses.
Turn the bayonet catches clockwise to lock the mixer houses.
Install the canister outlets on the canisters and make sure the locations and positions are correct.
Connect the outlet hoses to the mixers.

procedures.title: Brewer uitnemen en reinigen (Rosa)
procedures.intervalText: At least once a week, increase the frequency if needed.
procedures.purpose: Removal of the brewer is necessary for performing the cleaning procedure.

warnings.t: Do not take the brewer itself apart. Only properly trained personnel may work on the brewer itself. Instructions for performing work on the brewer itself is found in the technical manual.
When the machine is switched on take utmost care when performing maintenance.
You can turn the main shaft of the brewer with the blue brewer key (delivered with the machine).

steps.t: Tear off the filter paper on the left and right of the brewer.
Insert the service key in the door.
In the Service menu tap the [Replace filter paper] button.
s: The brewer chamber will move up to the open position.

steps.t: Remove the service key from the door.
Remove the brewer chamber by pulling it in the direction of the arrow.
Remove the remaining old filter paper from the brewer.
s: Lift the transport wheels with the cantilever if needed.

steps.t: Remove the nozzle / outlet pipe from the brewer.
Take the brewer out of the machine. First tilt the lower part of the brewer towards you to release the main shaft from the motor interlocking.
s: Tilting the lower part about 10 cm is enough.

steps.t: Lift the brewer a little to release the studs from the suspension and remove the brewer from the coffee machine.
Rinse the brewer with clean warm water.
Before installing, make sure the brewer chamber is still in the open position.
s: If needed, adjust the position of the main shaft to fit the motor interlocking.

steps.t: Place the studs at the back of the brewer in both suspension holes.
Lower the brewer down and make sure that the main shaft fits the motor interlocking.
s: Some force is needed to lock the brewer properly.

steps.t: Place the nozzle / outlet pipe on the brewer.
Guide the filter paper through the brewer, lift the transport wheels with the cantilever if needed.
s: for details, see section Place new filter paper.

steps.t: Install the brewer chamber. Press the brewer chamber with the two pins into position.
Insert the service key in the door.
In the Service menu tap the [Replace filter paper] button.
s: This will move the brewer through a cycle. Check if the filter paper is being transported properly and runs smoothly.

procedures.title: Brewer reinigen met reinigingstablet (Rosa)
procedures.intervalText: At least once a week, increase the frequency if needed.
procedures.purpose: Cleaning of the brewer with a tablet removes all coffee residue.
needed: Protective clothing, gloves and safety glasses.

warnings.t: Failure to clean the brewer weekly with the cleaning tablet available from the manufacturer will void the warranty on related parts. Not cleaning the brewer can cause the machine to malfunction!

• Total time for the cleaning cycle is 8 minutes. • A message is shown if the brewer is not cleaned after 7 days. • A message is shown and coffee dispense is disabled if the brewer is not cleaned after 9 days.
Depending on the model the button text can be different. ▪ Follow the instructions shown on-screen and described in the next steps.
Wear protective clothing, gloves and safety glasses when working with cleaning tablets.
Never cancel or interrupt the cleaning cycle. Repeat the full cleaning procedure if the cleaning cycle is not completely finished.

steps.t: Open the door of the machine if not already opened.
Insert the service key in the door.
Tear off and remove the used filter paper from the brewer. Check section Place new filter paper step 3, 4 and 5 for details.
From the Service Menu, tap the [Brewer Cleaning Cycle] button.
In the Service menu, tap [Next] to close the brewer chamber.
Wait until the next menu is displayed.
Place a cleaning tablet in the brewer chamber.
Place a rinsing tub or a 1 liter jug under the outlet nozzle.
In the Service Menu tap the button [Next] to start the actual cleaning cycle.
s: Wait until the cleaning cycle is completely finished and make sure the cleaning tablet is fully dissolved.

steps.t: Remove the service key from the door.
Guide the filter paper through the brewer. Check section Place new filter paper starting at step 7 for details.

procedures.title: Molen vrijmaken (Rosa)
procedures.purpose: Occasionally small twigs or small rocks (known as foreign objects) are in between the fresh beans. The grinder will stop if these objects are blocking the grinder. A message 'Grinder blocked' is displayed in the warning message area.

warnings.t: To prevent possible activation of the grinder(s), keep the door open and never place the service key.
Check the section Fill up the bean canister for details about the removal of the canisters. When the canister is removed, the grinder itself is visible.

steps.t: Locate the grinder that needs cleaning up.
Remove the canister to get access to the grinder.
To clean the grinder, lift and remove the grinder from the base.
Pull out the clips (1) of the grinder outlet, slide the outlet (2) from the grinder house and remove it from the grinder.
Loosen the bayonet locked grinder house top in the direction of the arrow and remove it from the grinder.
Clean both grinder discs and the inside of the grinder house.
Place the grinder house top assembly, and turn it in the direction of the arrow to lock.
Slide the outlet on the grinder house in the direction of the arrow.
s: Make sure the clips lock properly.

steps.t: Place the grinder back into the grinder base.
Place the canister back. TIP Check the last steps of the section Fill up the bean canister for more details.
Close the door and lock with the key.
Leave the Service menu. TIP Dispense two cups of coffee to fill up the grinder with fresh coffee and throw the contents of the cups away.
Check correct functioning by taking a test coffee.

procedures.title: Nieuw filterpapier plaatsen
procedures.intervalText: When needed.
procedures.purpose: Follow this procedure when the machine runs out of paper and a new roll of filter paper must be placed.
needed: Roll of recommended coffee filter paper.

warnings.t: Make sure the filter paper roll unrolls counter clock wise.
Make sure that the brewer is not moved down during lifting of the transport wheels. Push the cantilever down with your thumb while supporting the brewer with your index finger.

steps.t: Open the door of the machine.
Insert the service key in the door.
In the Service menu tap the [Replace filter paper] button.
s: Wait until the brewer chamber has moved to the open position.

steps.t: Remove the service key from the door.
Remove the old filter paper from the brewer.
s: Lift the transport wheels with the cantilever if needed.

steps.t: Place the new roll of filter paper.
Guide the filter paper to the brewer around the guiding wheels (6).
Lift the transport wheels (2) with the cantilever if needed.
Insert the service key in the door.
In the Service menu tap the [Replace filter paper] button.
s: The brewer moves a cycle and stops.

steps.t: Check if the filter paper is being transported correctly and that no folds or creases are in the paper.
Remove the service key from the door.
Check the functioning of the machine by taking a test drink (coffee).

procedures.title: Canisters reinigen (Rosa)
procedures.intervalText: Monthly, increase the frequency if needed
procedures.purpose: All ingredients leave residue inside the canister. To clean the canisters they need to be removed from the machine.

warnings.t: To prevent possible activation of the machine, never place the service key.
Use a mild detergent if warm water only is not sufficient.
Do not fill the canisters until they are completely dry. The product may form lumps which makes the system unusable.

steps.t: Open the door.
Open the top lid of the coffee machine.
Remove the canisters from the machine.
s: Check the first steps in the section Fill up the ingredient canisters for more details about the removal of the canisters.

steps.t: Unlock (optional) and remove the lid from the canisters.
Empty the canisters.
Clean the canisters with warm water.
Dry the canisters thoroughly on the inside and outside.

procedures.title: Koudwateruitloop reinigen (Rosa)
procedures.intervalText: Weekly, increase the frequency if needed (depending on machine usage and environmental conditions)
procedures.purpose: The cold water outlet nozzle must be cleaned regularly to prevent bacteria growth.
needed: Protective clothing, gloves and safety glasses.

warnings.t: Do not use aggressive cleaning products or abrasives to clean (parts of) the machine.
Wear protective clothing, gloves and safety glasses when working with cleaning chemicals.

steps.t: Use the cloth to apply the cleaning agent. Submerge a clean cloth into the cleaning agent (concentration recommended by cleaning agent manufacturer’s instructions). Remove the cloth and remove excess water.
Clean the cold water outlet nozzle wiping the cloth over the entire area re-submerging the cloth as necessary.
Rinse the cloth in clean warm water and wipe off excess cleaning agent residue and soil.
Dry cold water nozzle using disposable paper towels.
Close the door of the coffee machine.
Place a rinse tub below the cold water outlet nozzle.

procedures.title: Koudwateruitloop diepreinigen (Rosa)
procedures.intervalText: Monthly, increase the frequency if needed (depending on machine usage and environmental conditions)
procedures.purpose: The cold water outlet nozzle must be cleaned and disinfected regularly to prevent bacteria growth.
needed: Protective clothing, gloves and safety glasses.

warnings.t: Do not use aggressive cleaning products or abrasives to clean (parts of) the machine.
Wear protective clothing, gloves and safety glasses when working with cleaning chemicals.

steps.t: Submerge a clean cloth in warm water. Pre clean the cold water outlet nozzle using the cloth.
Submerge a clean cloth into the cleaning agent (concentration recommended by cleaning agent manufacturer’s instructions). Remove the cloth and remove excess water.
Clean the cold water outlet nozzle wiping the cloth over the entire area re-submerging the cloth as necessary.
Using a brush, brush around the cold water nozzle to dislodge any dried on soil. Remove the soil with a cloth.
Soak a clean disposable cloth in clean warm water and rinse the outlet nozzle until all soil and cleaning agent residues are removed.
Soak a clean disposable cloth in disinfectant solution, ensure that the whole area is wiped.
Leave for 10 minutes.
Rinse off disinfectant using disposable cloth in clean warm water.
Dry cold water nozzle with disposable paper towels.
Close the door of the coffee machine.
Place a rinse tub below the cold water outlet nozzle.
Leave the Service menu: Tap the [Exit] button and then the [OK] button to answer the question 'Do you want to leave the service menu' to leave the Service menu.
Select a full jug of cold water and dispense at least 1 liter of cold water and ensure any cleaning residue is flushed out.

procedures.title: Ingrediëntcanisters vullen (Rosa)
procedures.purpose: To prevent that the machine can no longer dispense drinks due to a lack of ingredients, the machine must be refilled in time.

warnings.t: • Make sure that the canisters remain filled with a layer of at least (4 cm) of product. • Only use ingredients recommended by the supplier of the machine. • To fill up a bean canister (optional) check the section Fill up the bean canister.
To prevent possible activation of the machine, never place the service key.
Filling the canisters must be done outside the machine.
Make sure the drive at the back of the canister fits well on the motor drive.
Check the position of the outlet of the canister. It must be positioned towards the correct mixing bowl.

steps.t: Open the door.
Open the top lid of the coffee machine.
Remember (or write down) the position of the outlets and turn the outlets of the canisters upwards.
Slightly lift the canister at the front until the small locking ridge (see inset) is visible.
Pull the canister towards you and take it out of the machine.
Remove the lid and place the canister on a stable surface.
Fill the canister with the ingredient indicated on the canister. TIP Do not fill the canisters more than necessary for one or two days. This will keep the products fresh.
Place the lid back on the canister and position the canister back into the machine.
Turn the outlets of the canister downwards.
Close the top lid of the machine.

procedures.title: Bonencanister vullen (Rosa)
procedures.purpose: In order to prevent that the machine can no longer dispense drinks due to a lack of ingredients, the machine must be refilled in time.

warnings.t: • Make sure that the canisters remain filled with a layer of at least 4 cm of product. • Only use ingredients recommended by the supplier of the machine. • To fill up an ingredient canister (optional) check the section Fill up the ingredient canisters.
To prevent possible activation of the grinder(s), never place the service key.
Filling the canisters must be done outside the machine.
When the canister locking slider is not fully pulled out, coffee beans will fall out of the canister.

steps.t: Open the door.
Open the top lid of the coffee machine.
Locate the canister locking slider in between the grinder and the bean canister.
Pull the canister locking slider in the direction of the arrow. The bean canister will be closed and unlocked from the grinder base.
Lift the bean canister from the grinder base and take it out of the machine.
Place the bean canister on a stable and flat surface for refilling.
Unlock the lid (optional). Lift the lid in the front and then pull the lid from the canister in the direction of the arrow.
Fill the canister with fresh coffee beans. TIP Fill the canister with beans sufficient for one or two days. This will keep the products fresh.
Place the back side of the lid on the canister and then lower the front side. Lock the lid (optional).
Place the bean canister back into the coffee machine on the four position ridges of the grinder base.
Push the canister locking slider back in the direction of the arrow to open the bean canister and secure it to the grinder base.
Repeat the procedure if more bean canisters must be filled up.

procedures.title: Touchless Interface: prepare the software
procedures.intervalText: Once, before you go to the customer.
procedures.purpose: The Touchless Interface lets the customer order a drink by scanning a QR code on the machine with their phone. For that, MoVeC 5.30 or higher, the matching interface version and two .ipk files have to get onto the machine. You prepare them at home or at the office on two empty USB sticks.
needed: Two empty USB sticks, formatted FAT32

warnings.t: Check in the stick's properties that it really is FAT32; with another file system the machine will not read it.

steps.t: Insert the first empty USB stick into the computer.
Go to www.dejongduke.nl and log in to the 'My DJD' environment.
Open the 'Software' tab of the machine model the Touchless Interface is going onto.
Open the 'MoVeC application' bar and click 'Download ICEQ2 movec application 5.30'.
Copy the downloaded file to the first USB stick.
Safely remove the first USB stick from the computer.
Insert the second empty USB stick into the computer.
Open the 'MoVeC Flash Interface' bar and download 'xxxx interface 3.11'.
s: xxxx is the name of the machine model you are installing on.

steps.t: Open the 'Programs' bar and click 'Download touchless ENABLE'.
Scroll to ConnectMe at the bottom of the page, open the 'Software' tab, open the 'Activation files' bar and download 'restclient DISABLE'.
s: This file switches off the default connection to the ConnectMe servers, which otherwise uses data every 5 minutes.

steps.t: Copy the three files to the second USB stick.
Safely remove the second USB stick from the computer.

The .ipk files are installed automatically.

touchless-enable_1.0.ipk

procedures.title: Testing the Touchless Interface
procedures.intervalText: After installation, before you sign off with the customer.
procedures.purpose: Checking that the customer really can order a drink with their phone.
needed: A smartphone with a camera and internet

steps.t: Scan the QR code on the machine with a smartphone.
The QR code gives a link to a web page. Open that link.
The page lists the drinks that can be ordered through the Touchless Interface.
Pick a drink, put a cup or jug under the outlet and tap ‘Order’.
The drink is dispensed.

procedures.intervalText: With a fault message about the Touchless Interface.
procedures.purpose: What you check yourself before you call technical support.

steps.t: Restart the machine: switch it off, wait 10 seconds and switch it on again.
Wait at least 5 minutes and see whether the Touchless Interface works now.
If it still does not work, check the internet connection of the dongle.
s: Service menu -> Connectivity -> View Network info; it has to say ‘Server connection OK’.

steps.t: Check that the serial number in ‘Software information’ matches the type plate.
If that does not help, call technical support.

procedures.title: General
procedures.purpose: The 12 bar safety valve is one of several safeguards in the coffee machine. To make sure the safety valve works properly it must be tested regularly. A separate directive called Recommended Service Information contains renewal periods for all essential parts in the coffee machine and is available on request. This instruction gives a full description of how to test the 12 bar safety valve and how to replace it. It is the owner's responsibility to make sure the coffee machines are safe to use and conform to all safety regulations and local laws (e.g. Safety of Pressure Systems 2000 in the United Kingdom).

warnings.t: Always replace the safety valve if local laws or replacement directives say so, even if tests show that the valve works fine.

procedures.title: Pressure Systems Safety Regulations 2000 (PSSR)
procedures.purpose: The Pressure Systems Safety Regulations 2000 (PSSR) cover the safe design and use of pressure systems. The aim of PSSR is to prevent serious injury from the hazard of stored energy (pressure) as a result of the failure of a pressure system or one of its component parts. This document gives you more information about our machines regarding the PSSR 2000. Machine hot water pressure system Pressure Systems Safety Regulations 2000 (PSSR) Pressure boiler Vessel category SEP Operating pressure (standard) atmospheric Nominal operating pressure (dynamic) pumped 0-10 bar Test pressure (design) 24 bar Pressure safety device 12 bar Nominal operating temperature (max. operating) 92 ±10 °C Safety device cutoff temperature (clixon) 110 ±5 °C

warnings.t: This document does not in any way replace official and legal documentation regarding the PSSR 2000 and the duties of the owner and/or user. Official and legal documentation is leading at all times. Always follow our instructions for maintenance and yearly replacement of the safety relief valves.

procedures.purpose: The add-on water set only contains a double valve. In the coffee machine, check the two valve stacks, mounted to the open boiler to determine if the double valve can be used or only a single valve. If one of the valve stacks is a single valve (A - in the example above), replace that valve with the new double valve from the set. procedures.title: Testing the 12 bar safety valve
procedures.purpose: Follow the procedure to test the 12 bar safety valve. 1. Open the door of the coffee machine. ▪ The Service Menu is opened. 2. Make sure the waste water bucket (a small bucket, inside the larger waste bucket) is dry. 3. Place the service key in the door. 4. Log in. ▪ The main menu is displayed. 5. Depending on the menu version: ▪ A. Tap the [Hardware] button and then the [Test outputs] tab. ▪ B. Scroll down (using the page down [PgDwn] button) and tap the [Test outputs] button. 6. Finally, tap the [Test 12 bar] button to start the test. ▪ The pump(s) will start immediately. After some time, the 12 bar safety valve is activated and opened. A small amount of water (see picture) will be flowing through the drain hoses and is visible in the small bucket or waste water bin in the base cabinet. If so, the 12 bar safety valve works properly. If no water is visible, replace the 12 bar safety valve. The replacement procedure is explained in the next chapter.

warnings.t: If a waste guide is installed, make sure that the waste (water) bin in the base cabinet is dry.
Before continuing the procedure, give the boilers some time to heat up properly.
In some situations it is possible that the pumps are switched off before the 12 bar pressure is reached. To make sure the valve is not working, repeat step 6 one more time.
A safety valve can not be repaired.

The replacement is valid for small and medium coffee machines with PPSU manifolds and outlet valves. 1. Switch off the machine. 2. Remove the screws in the lower back cover. 3. Remove (CND and XNA) or tilt down (CEC and XEA) the lower back cover. 4. Locate the manifold with the safety valves. Small model (T0) Medium model (T1) A. CND model with CoEx brewer C. CEC model with CoEx brewer B. XNA model with CoEx XL brewer D. XEA model with CoEx XL brewer 5. To remove the 12 bar valve, first push in and hold the collet (B) of the PPSU fitting (A) and pull out both the Insert connection and 12 bar safety valve (C). 6. Remove the 12 bar safety valve from the hose. 7. Use a split plier and a wrench to separate the insert connection from the 12 bar safety valve. 8. Take a new 12 bar safety valve, place a new sealing ring (A) and secure them together with the insert connection. ▪ Tighten properly using a split plier and wrench. 9. Connect the fitting to the hose. 10. Insert the metal insert connection into the PPSU fitting. ▪ Try to pull it out to check if it locks properly. 11. Repeat the safety valve test from the previous chapter and check if the new safety valve works. 12. Close the cabinet and take a test drink.

warnings.t: Turn off machine power using the switch inside the machine and unplug the machine power plug from the wall power socket.

procedures.title: How to load a new configuration file from an USB stick
procedures.purpose: Login > Software > Configuration The MoVeC files have the extension .mvq. 1. Copy the new file to a USB stick. 2. Insert the USB stick in the USB port of the machine. ▪ check the door interior drawing and look for the USB port. 3. Wait for about half a minute, the machine must read the stick first. 4. Login in the Service Menu. 5. Select the [Software] button. 6. Tap the [Load configuration from USB] button. 7. Select the available device (most of the times: Device 0). 8. Select the desired configuration on the USB stick. ▪ The selected configuration is now loaded and automatically started. 9. Remove the USB stick. 10. Ready.

warnings.t: If the coffee machine can not be started properly, create an empty file with the name 'configsetup' (do NOT add any extention) on the USB stick. When the USB stick is inserted in the USB port of the machine, the command forces the machine to load the configuration file and also activate the configuration file on the machine.

Select the [Software] button.
Tap the [Load configuration from USB] button.

Select the desired configuration on the USB stick. ▪ The selected configuration is now loaded and automatically started.

procedures.title: How to load Application or User Interface files from USB
procedures.purpose: SPK, IPK and FW files are used for packaging User Interface files, the MoVeC Application files and other software. 1. Copy the file(s) to an empty USB stick. ▪ Make sure the file(s) are placed in the root directory and not in a sub directory. ▪ Make sure the file format of the USB stick is FAT32. 2. Open the door of an active machine and insert the USB stick in the USB port in(-side) the door. ▪ The machine will recognize the file(s) and upload automatically. 3. Wait approximately 30 seconds until the touchscreen goes black for 2 seconds. ▪ In case a FW-file is uploaded the screen will display additional progress information. ▪ The software on the machine is now updated. 4. Remove the USB stick. 5. Check the Machine information screen from the service menu to make sure the new software version is active.

procedures.title: How to calibrate the touchscreen
procedures.purpose: The touchscreen is calibrated in the factory but can be recalibrated with the 'tscalibrate' command. 1. Create an empty file with the name 'tscalibrate' on an empty USB stick. 2. Insert the USB stick in the USB port of the machine. (inside the door). 3. The calibration program starts and will show crosses on the screen in sequence. Four in the corners and one in the middle. 4. Tap the crosses to determine the position of the coordinates on the touchscreen. 5. The machine will restart itself. 6. Check if beverages can be selected. 7. Remove the USB stick. 8. Ready.

Ready.

procedures.title: How to create a log file
procedures.purpose: In some cases the support department can request a log file of the coffee machine. The command movecinfo can be used to create a log file. 1. Create an empty file with the name 'Movecinfo' on an empty USB stick. 2. Insert the USB stick in the USB port of the machine (inside the door). 3. The command is recognized, the log file (movecinfo- YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.txt) is created on the USB stick. 4. When finished, the screen will switch off shortly. 5. Remove the USB stick. 6. Ready.

procedures.title: How to descale the boiler of the coffee machine (Avy, Blu, Lina, Lua, Virtu, Zia)
procedures.purpose: Purpose Depending on the water quality, limescale can build up inside the pressure (and steam - depending on the model) boiler, hoses and other areas of the coffee machine. Limescale can damage the machine and affect the quality of the dispensed drinks. The descaling process removes the buildup of limescale. The total time to descale the coffee machine is about 45 minutes. This includes the preparations, the 10 minute wait for the liquid to dissolve the limescale, and the final rinsing time to make sure all descaling liquid and limescale has been removed from the hot water system. Required • Torx 15 screwdriver • Descaling liquid • Descale suction hose, pressure hose L=35cm, or a suction hose prepared with shut-off valve (see preparation section) • 1.5 liter measuring cup for the descaling liquid mix • The Descale program is available in the Service Menu > Login > Hardware > Descale • Large waste bucket Interval Perform this procedure: • Every 6 months, depending on the water quality (hardness) and additional water filtering Procedure The descale procedure is split up in 4 parts for a medium model coffee machine with one pressure boiler: ACTION DESCRIPTION TIME (min) AMOUNT (liter) Preparation mix liquid, create suction hose Descale load descale liquid descale soaking period 0.6 at least Rinse descale hose load clean water for hose 0.5 First full rinse load clean water 0.9 brewer 0.2 expansion valve Second full rinse load clean water again same as previous step Successful completion close machine Prepare Descale Suction Hose 1. If the machine contains a hose clamp (3), the clamp can be used as a shut-off valve. A simple pressure hose with L=35cm max. can be inserted in the drain hose (2) and used as a descale suction hose. 2. For coffee machines without the clamp, a suction hose with shut-off valve is needed, similar as shown in the picture. ▪ Prepare the hose and make sure that the length (L2) of hose (4) is not more than 30 cm. Parts: 1. Knee. 2. Pressure hose (L1=4cm). 3. Shut-off valve (shown in 'open' position) 4. Pressure hose (L2 max 30cm). Prepare Descaling Liquid 1. Mix the recommended amount* of descaling liquid with 1 liter water in a measuring cup. *) Refer to the dilution percentage recommended by the manufacturer of the descaling liquid. Start procedure 1. Close the tap to the water supply. ▪ But leave the machine connected to the water supply. 2. Remove the lower back panel. 3. Locate the drain hose between the main water inlet and the pumps. 4. Remove the plug from the push-in fitting / drain hose. 5. Depending on the situation: ▪ If the hose uses a clamp: insert the simple descale suction hose into the hose. Leave the clamp closed. ▪ If the clamp is not used: insert the knee of the prepared suction hose with shut-off valve in the push-in fitting. Make sure the shut-off valve is CLOSED. 6. Insert the other end of the descale suction hose in the prepared descaling liquid. 7. Empty the drip tray and the waste bucket. 8. Open the door of the machine and keep it opened. ▪ The Service Menu is displayed. ▪ Do not enter the service key. 9. Place the waste bucket under the outlets. 10. Disconnect the hot water hose in the door and lead this hose to the waste bucket as well. Load descale liquid 1. Login in the Service Menu. Tap the [Hardware] button, scroll down and tap the [Descale] tab. 1. Tap the [Start] button to start the descale procedure. ▪ The first screen of the procedure is shown. 2. Open the shut-off valve / clamp in the descale suction hose. 3. Place the service key. 4. Tap the [Next] button. ▪ The descaling liquid is pumped into the boilers and out, through the hot water outlet, the mixers the brewer and the expansion valve. ▪ The message "Descaling in progress. Please wait" is shown. 5. A waiting period (about 10 minutes) starts to allow the liquid to dissolve the scale. 6. Wait until the next screen of the procedure is shown. 7. Empty the waste bucket and the drip tray. Rinse - clean descale suction hose 1. Fill a bucket with 0.5 liter clean water. 2. Insert the descale suction hose in the bucket with clean water. 3. From the menu, tap the [Next] button. ▪ The descale suction hose is rinsed with clean water (0,5 liter for 2 minutes) using the hot water valve. ▪ The message "Tube rinse in progress. Please wait" is shown. 4. Wait until the next screen of the procedure is shown. 5. Remove the descale suction hose from the fitting. 6. Insert the stop/plug in the drain hose. 7. If the white clamp is used, close the white clamp. 8. Empty the waste bucket and the drip tray. Rinse 1 - full system 1. Open the water supply. 2. In the menu, tap the [Next] button. ▪ The system is rinsed using all water outputs with clean water. ▪ The message "Rinse system in progress. Please wait" is shown. 3. Wait until the next screen of the procedure is shown. 4. Empty the waste bucket and the drip tray. Rinse 2 - full system 1. In the menu, tap the [Next] button. ▪ The full system rinse will be repeated. ▪ The message "Rinse system in progress. Please wait" is shown. 2. Wait until the "Descaling finished" message is shown. 3. Empty the waste bucket and the drip tray. Successful Completion - back to normal operation 1. Connect the hot water hose to the water outlet connector in the door. 2. Tap the [Done] button to finish the descaling procedure. 3. Install the back panel of the machine. 4. Close the door of the machine. 5. Take a test beverage or run the daily cleaning cycle.

warnings.t: The open boiler is not included in this descaling program but can, if needed, be descaled manually.
Take care, a small amount of hot water can leak from the fitting.
Make sure that the hot water hose ends INSIDE the bucket.
When the water tap is not closed, water will fill up the measuring cup with descaling liquid.

procedures.title: Requirements
procedures.purpose: Safety Before installing the coffee machine, please read the safety and installation related instructions in the section Safety first. Location Check the section Required installation space to make sure that the coffee machine will have enough space and can be serviced properly. Electrical connection The coffee machine needs to be connected to a power wall socket directly. • The length of the power cable is about 2 m. • Refer to the information on the type plate and check if the wall socket can be used. • Make sure that the wall socket will be accessible after final installation of the coffee machine. Water connection Always use an electric water lock between water tap and coffee machine. • Check the Technical specifications for the minimum required water quality. ▪ Use a water filter if the water quality is outside the required values. Internet connection Check if a (wireless) network connection is available. • A network connection is needed to use the Touchless Interface or ConnectMe. • A separate installation manual is available if the machine does not have a network connector. Waste water disposal Check if the coffee machine is prepared to use a fixed waste water connection. • A separate installation manual is available if the machine is not prepared for a fixed waste water connection.

procedures.title: Unpacking
procedures.purpose: Unpack the machine Place the packed machine near the desired location. • Preferably on the same level and surface. • Make sure that the arrows on the box point upwards. Procedure Perform the following steps: 1. Open the front of the box. 2. Remove the canister box and additional filling material from the top of the machine. 3. Use the cardboard handle underneath the machine to pull the machine out of the box.

warnings.t: Make sure you don't dispose of any spare parts and accessories inside the packaging.

Connect the chiller (optional). ▪ A separate instruction manual is available with detailed information. 3. Connect the water hose(s). ▪ Adjust the water pressure reducer if needed. 4. Insert the power plug in the wall socket. 5. Position the machine on the final location. 6. Switch on the coffee machine.

procedures.title: Configuration and fine tuning
procedures.purpose: To simplify the correct configuration process, the Service Menu contains an Installation procedure. Tap the [Installation] button for a guide line to all relevant settings or follow the steps below. 1. Make sure the latest release of the MoVeq application is loaded. ▪ Check the Software information screen for more details. 2. Make sure the correct configuration is activated. ▪ Check the Software configurations screen for more details. 3. Configure if the coffee machine needs to keep track when the water filter needs to be replaced or not. ▪ Check the Water filter settings for more details. 4. Check if the machine is connected to ConnectMe. ▪ Check the Organization Code in the Connectivity screen for more details. ▪ A separate manual is available with more details. 5. Fill up all canisters with ingredients. ▪ Calibrate (optional) and set the canister filling levels in the Canister settings screen. 6. If a payment unit is used (internal and/or external), check the payment settings. 7. Adjust the grinding degree of the grinder(s) to match the coffee beans (optional). ▪ Check the Change the grinding degree section for more details. 8. Take a test drink. 9. Inform the user about usage and regular cleaning procedures.

warnings.t: By showing the 'Brewer cleaning cycle' you also make sure that the cleaning counter will start counting from day one.
